messages:
maria: Hey team, just escalated from a customer — in prod they see streaming responses cut off when their client triggers an AbortController during a reconnect. They get partial JSON and no final "done" chunk, but tokens were billed twice for the same request id. Request id: rq_0a7c3f. Browser app using our JS SDK v2.3.1.

alex: Thanks, maria. Can you paste the minimal repro or logs? Is this EventSource in the browser or a node polyfill?

maria: Browser EventSource in Chrome 114. Repro steps are short: 1) start fetch with our streaming SDK open iterator 2) rotate auth token mid-stream (we call refreshToken in app) 3) client aborts old controller and reopens iterator 4) sometimes the final chunk never arrives, and server logs show two invoice-eligible completions.

tim: That pattern smells like a race between our client-side iterator close and the server's final flush. Did they see any 401 or 204?

maria: No 401s seen. Server responded 200, then we see a tiny chunk like 'data: {"delta":"hi"}\n\n' then connection spawns reconnect and client never emits final frame. Dev says it happened 3x in a 10k-user alpha.

sara: Can you ask them to run with SDK DEBUG=redwood:sse and paste the stream trace? Also which api endpoint variant — /v1/stream or /v1/chat/stream?

maria: They attached a short trace (pasted):

```
DEBUG redwood:sse event: open
DEBUG redwood:sse got: data: {"id":"tok_abc","delta":"hello"}\nDEBUG redwood:sse got: event: heartbeat
DEBUG redwood:sse got: data: {"id":"tok_abc","delta":" world"}\nDEBUG redwood:sse connection closed by client abort
DEBUG redwood:sse reconnecting with resume param
DEBUG redwood:sse got: data: {"id":"tok_abc","delta":"!","done":true}
DEBUG redwood:sse iterator closed before emitting final chunk
```

alex: That log is key: server produced final chunk after reconnect, but iterator was already closed locally. Likely the iterator close handler doesn't wait for an in-flight final frame when a resume occurs. Also double billing could be because resume triggered a duplicate finalization event counted twice.

nina: Tagging eng-runtime. @tim can you pick up? I'm creating support ticket SUP-1942 and assigning oncall.

tim: On it. Quick questions — which SDK build handles resume logic? v2.3.1 has an async iterator that swallows the final chunk if AbortController.signal was used concurrently. I can reproduce with a tiny script.

sara: If you can repro, capture a HAR or use curl with --http2 to simulate. Also check for missing 'event: done' vs 'data: {"done":true}' formats. We had edge cases with attribute ordering.

tim: Repro script I used (node):

```
const {createStream} = require('redwood-js-sdk');
const controller = new AbortController();
(async () => {
  const it = await createStream({model:'gpt-lite'}, {signal: controller.signal});
  setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 80); // abort while server is about to send final
  try {
    for await (const chunk of it) {
      console.log('chunk', chunk);
    }
  } catch (e) { console.error('iter err', e); }
})();
```

This reproduces 20% of runs for me locally against a dev instance. The SDK's AsyncIterator has an internal `closed` flag set when abort happens and it returns before processing queued final event.

maria: Customer also reported charges for both attempts (they saw two billing entries within 1s). Any mitigation we can advise them now?

sara: Short term mitigation: avoid aborting mid-stream, instead let stream finish or use server-side 'should_continue' to politely cancel. Also downgrade to v2.2.8 if feasible (it waits for final frame). We'll prepare a hotfix for v2.3.x.

nina: Please add a note to the customer about workarounds and that we're investigating. I've scheduled a hotfix slot in the next patch window and marked this P2->P1 if we confirm duplicate billing.

tim: Debug notes for engineers: iterator.close() sets closed=true and resolves pending promise immediately. Need to change to await flush of internal event queue if final chunk seen within X ms, or mark final chunk as authoritative and dedupe server finalization event. Also add telemetry to mark when final_chunk arrives after client-closed.

sara: We should also add unit tests: simulate mid-stream token rotation + AbortController + server final after reconnect. Add a repro test in sdk/streaming/tests/reconnect-final.test.ts.

maria: Customer reply: 'ok we'll try the workaround and report back, thanks.'

deploy-bot: ticket SUP-1942 created — linked to GH issue redwood/sdk#1218. Assigned to tim.

tim: I'll open a PR with a conservative delay/flush approach and include opt-in env REDWOOD_SSE_STRICT=false to avoid regressions. I'll post the PR link when ready.

sara: Also flag billing to avoid charging duplicate token counts while this is investigated. Ops, please hold billing for rq_0a7c3f until we confirm.

nina: Ops notified. Thanks everyone. We'll update the thread after PR lands and we validate with customer.
